name: TV/Commercial Display Production Line Solutions
summary: Full line automation solutions for TV, commercial display, educational conference all-in-one, and digital signage manufacturers, covering the entire process of dispensing, laminating, flipping, inspection, bagging, and palletizing.
contentHtml:
The TV/Commercial Display Flexible Assembly Line is a full line automation solution provided by TXAM for manufacturers of TV, commercial displays, educational conference all-in-one, and digital signage.

Solution Composition

The full line covers the entire process from dispensing, bracket placement, laminating, flip inspection, to final bagging and palletizing, achieving fully automated production from raw materials to finished products.

Technical Advantages

  • One-click compatibility with 65-110 inch multi-size products, solving large-size production challenges
  • Full process robotic automation, significantly improving production efficiency
  • CAD import for one-click model changeover, short debugging time, minimal capacity loss
  • High overall line yield rate, consistent product quality
  • Self-developed WMS/WCS system, breaking information silos
  • True turnkey project, one-stop service

Service Content

TXAM provides full process support from solution design, equipment manufacturing, installation and commissioning to after-sales service, truly realizing a turnkey project.

painPoints.title: Difficulty in Large-Size Assembly
painPoints.desc: Manual assembly of large-size display devices over 65 inches is difficult, inefficient, and has a high breakage rate

painPoints.title: Complex Multi-Model Changeover
painPoints.desc: Long changeover time for multi-model production, high debugging costs, difficult to achieve flexible production

painPoints.title: High Risk in Manual Flipping
painPoints.desc: Flipping large-size products relies on manual labor, posing safety hazards and risk of product damage

painPoints.title: Insufficient Dispensing Accuracy
painPoints.desc: Traditional dispensing equipment has low precision, many bubbles, and cannot guarantee sealing performance

painPoints.title: Low Packaging Efficiency
painPoints.desc: Post-process packaging is cumbersome, with high manual bagging and palletizing costs and slow cycle times

painPoints.title: Severe Information Silos
painPoints.desc: Lack of information exchange between equipment, making digital management and quality traceability difficult

process.title: Automatic Dispensing
process.desc: High-precision robotic dispensing with ±0.2mm positioning accuracy, multi-nozzle matrix coordination

process.title: Precision Laminating
process.desc: Constant pressure control laminating with ±0.15mm accuracy, no bubbles, no misalignment

process.title: Safe Flipping
process.desc: 180-degree heavy-duty flipping with one-button operation, solving large-size product flipping challenges

process.title: Visual Inspection
process.desc: AI vision system for automatic inspection, online quality control, ensuring product consistency

process.title: Automatic Bagging
process.desc: Robotic automatic bagging packaging, saving labor, improving packaging efficiency

process.title: Intelligent Palletizing
process.desc: Six-axis robot intelligent palletizing with ±0.5mm accuracy, 12 seconds per piece for efficient palletizing

process.title: One-Click Model Changeover
process.desc: CAD drawing import for quick product model switching, significantly reducing debugging time

process.title: Data Traceability
process.desc: WMS/WCS system enables transparent production data, full quality traceability
